description: This file is a PHP source file for the Locale module of SuiteCRM, handling localization settings in the administration interface. It manages configuration, displays locale options, and processes user input related to locale preferences.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: Class responsible for handling configuration settings within the SuiteCRM administration module.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template rendering class for Smarty templates used in SuiteCRM's admin interface.

classes.name: Locale
classes.description: Locale handling class providing methods for locale options, name formats, and validation.

methods.name: invalidLocaleNameFormatUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if there is an upgrade needed for invalid locale name formats.

methods.name: removeInvalidLocaleNameFormatUpgradeNotice
methods.description: Removes notices related to invalid locale name formats.

methods.name: getUsableLocaleNameOptions
methods.description: Returns locale name options that can be used in the interface.

methods.name: getCharsetSelect
methods.description: Provides charset options for locale configuration.

methods.name: getNameJs
methods.description: Retrieves JavaScript related to locale name handling.
